objective: Improve geometric-mean DOM and On-Demand JSON parsing throughput across frozen mixed corpora at simdjson 8e6bac94 while preserving exact event hashes, malformed-input errors, the full relevant upstream test set, and peak RSS.

meta.license: Apache-2.0 OR MIT (upstream LICENSE and LICENSE-MIT preserved)
meta.provenance: Pinned public source simdjson/simdjson@8e6bac94877f2d3d026000d36ce81e0aaf38d26f; upstream jsonexamples plus deterministic generated JSON; current-head A-A qReference construction is frozen after local calibration.

sourceDetails.mutableSurface: src/generic parsing kernels and architecture implementation translation units; public headers, evaluator, build files, benchmark harness, tests, fixtures, and expected hashes are protected
sourceDetails.upstreamHarness: hone/verify.cpp trusted event harness (parent-timed; no self-reported throughput consumed)

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max
measurement.q: geometric mean of candidate/reference speed ratios for full-document DOM and On-Demand parses across the three frozen corpora; two-point (N vs 2N iterations) wall clock measured in the trusted evaluator parent around the non-self-reporting harness, reference parser rebuilt from frozen trusted sources in the same eval and timed back-to-back (per-point minimum across samples), never a self-reported number from candidate-linked code; timed iterations are identity-distinct (trusted harness deterministically perturbs value bytes before every iteration after the first, structure and size preserved) and every perturbed iteration's full event stream is folded into a chain the parent validates against the trusted reference's chain at the same iteration count, so repeated timed work can neither be memoized nor skipped
measurement.peakRssGate: candidate harness peak RSS <= per-split frozen baseline (protected asset) * 1.05
measurement.validationOracle: expected event hashes and RSS baselines live only in the protected asset mount (assets/<split>/expected.json), outside the candidate-readable workspace and corpus; perturbed-iteration chains are pinned per iteration count by the trusted reference binary within each eval, and candidate-writable residue (/tmp, /dev/shm, SysV IPC) is purged between launches

normalization.status: provisional local locked A-A calibration; final frozen GCE like-for-like re-calibration required
